label: Stop order is fixed and script-owned: cap, failures, stuck, mode off, stop-policy max-iterations, STOP candidate, minIterations floor, quality guards, graph decision.

Research progress is measured against the init-time question registry (totalQuestions = answered + open); all_questions_answered is a STOP candidate that skips the weighted vote; no signal counts unexplored scope.

Weighted vote: rollingAverage<0.05 (0.30), MAD noise floor (0.35), questionEntropy answered fraction >=0.85 (0.35); unavailable signals leave the denominator so early iterations are decided by questionEntropy alone.
newInfoRatio is self-reported and focus-relative; drilling one focus lowers it; the novelty-corroboration guard can only veto a stop, never add scope.
minIterations is a lower bound only (default 3) and research-only; the review loop has no minIterations floor.
focusAlignment quality guard fails when an iteration answers a question outside its keyQuestions, penalizing emergent-question widening.
sourceDiversity guard (>=2 sources per answered question) deepens evidence per question, not scope.

Graph STOP_ALLOWED thresholds (questionCoverage 0.7, claimVerification 0.6, contradiction 0.15, sourceDiversity 1.5, evidenceDepth 1.5) are ratios over existing nodes; none measures an unvisited frontier; graph is a veto layer.
Stuck path yields STUCK_RECOVERY on low ratios; insight resets the count; recovery does not widen scope.
convergenceMode off and stopPolicy max-iterations extend duration, not direction.

Config-dir defect refined: explicit --claude-config-dir with --loop-type research is loudly rejected by validateFlags; only the review branch sets CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR via guardContext env; research-branch ambient env inheritance unverified.
